## Write to me

[shunyu.wu@cornell.edu](mailto:shunyu.wu@cornell.edu)

I welcome conversations about learning physical dynamics for control and optimization. My application interests include water-energy systems, the sustainable operation of multi-energy systems serving data centers, and precision materials manufacturing.

## Current appointment

**Ezra Systems Postdoctoral Associate**<br>
Systems Engineering Program<br>
Cornell University, Ithaca, New York

I work with [Professor Fengqi You](https://www.peese.org/professor/) on dynamic modeling and optimization for precision materials manufacturing.
